item.description:
Connector 0.1.6

Automations for Tumult Hype 4.

This version introduces a seven-day trial and paid licenses. Automation requires an active trial or license. Start your trial explicitly in License, with no payment card or automatic purchase.

  • Buy a license or request your license key again from the app.
  • Activate a license on up to two Macs.
  • CLI, MCP and AppleScript share the app's license.
  • Signed updates and downloads remain available through GitHub.

After installing the bundled plugin, save your work and restart Hype when convenient to load it. Connector does not restart Hype automatically.
